findings.finding: Key: From sum‑transfer: b+ B=10, a+ A=20. Use A=20−a, B=10−b. Equations become a(20−a)=4b(10−b) and a(15−a)=b(15−b). Brute‑force a∈1..15, b∈1..10 → only (a,b)=(10,5). Product=50.
Key: From sums: A+a=20, B+b=10 (since X=2Y and X−Y=10). Use a=20−A, b=10−B. Equations: A(20−A)=4B(10−B) and A(15−A)=B(15−B). Brute‑force A≤15, B≤10 → only (A,B)=(10,5). Product=50.
